summary: Work Orders to Invoices – Part Description presentation (Capitalization not preserved)
reported_issue: On WO S-1820 Line 1 a part description entered in full caps ('HEATED HEADLIGHT') was force-converted to lowercase ('heated headlight') on the generated invoice. The system was not preserving the user's original capitalization.
expected_after_fix: Text formatting should be preserved exactly as entered; capitalization must remain unchanged on the final invoice. 'HEATED HEADLIGHT' entered => 'HEATED HEADLIGHT' on invoice.
steps_i_followed: Booted SPA as admin (exact WO S-1820 is customer/production data, so inferred repro using an existing staging invoice that contains an ALL-CAPS part description).
Opened paid WO S9-24674 => Finance tab, which renders the generated invoice preview.
Located the invoice line-item part descriptions and read their exact casing.
Inspected the computed CSS text-transform on the description elements.
actual_now: Capitalization is preserved on the invoice. The invoice line items render the part description in the same ALL-CAPS as entered: 'N68SL-356 - 3.50-3.82" (89-97mm) SPRING LOADED T-BOLT CLAMP' and 'Core for ... SPRING LOADED T-BOLT CLAMP'. Computed style text-transform = 'none' on the description cells, so no forced lowercasing occurs. No caps->lowercase conversion observed.
notes: Original WO S-1820 (SS Repair Ltd) is not on the disposable staging shop, so tested with an existing staging invoice containing caps descriptions. Casing is preserved end-to-end (line -> invoice) and CSS text-transform is 'none'. Confidence medium since the exact original record was not reproducible.
